title: Ada Research
subtitle: A Critical Tutorial — from a single point in space to the edge of chaos and beyond

chapters.name: Primitives: Points Build Worlds
chapters.truth: A point is position without extension. Everything is built from nothing.

chapters.name: Transformation: What Stays the Same When Everything Changes
chapters.truth: Identity preserved under transformation. What stays the same when everything changes? Invariants define structure; transformations reveal what matters.

chapters.name: Color and Composition
chapters.truth: Color is perception, not physics. RGB is a lie we agree on. What you see depends on context, not wavelength alone.

chapters.name: Change: Rate, Accumulation, and Flow
chapters.truth: Things change. Change accumulates. Accumulation flows.

chapters.name: Vectors & Forces: From Direction to Dynamics
chapters.truth: Direction + magnitude = vector. F = ma. Acceleration is the only thing you feel. Position and velocity are states; force is what changes them.

chapters.name: Wavefunctions: Everything Oscillates
chapters.truth: Everything oscillates. Fourier shows every signal is a sum of sines. The wave is the fundamental pattern of non-rest—perpetual movement between poles.

chapters.name: Randomness: Freedom from Pattern
chapters.truth: Entropy is not decay — it is the size of the possible.

chapters.name: Noise: Entropy with Memory
chapters.truth: Noise is randomness that remembers its neighbors. Structured disorder, organic unpredictability.

chapters.name: Cellular Automata: Local Rules, Global Patterns
chapters.truth: Local rules, global patterns. Each cell knows only its neighbors, yet worlds emerge. Rule 110 is Turing complete—simple rules can compute anything.

chapters.name: Fractals: Infinite Within Finite
chapters.truth: Infinite complexity from finite rules. Dimensions between integers. D = log(N)/log(S). Self-similarity across scales.

chapters.name: L-Systems: Rules Grow Structure
chapters.truth: A sentence can become a forest. Grammar is generative.

chapters.name: Procedural Generation: Rules Build Worlds
chapters.truth: A world doesn't need an author. Rules and randomness are enough.

chapters.name: Soft Bodies & Morphogenesis: Matter That Finds Its Shape
chapters.truth: Form is not imposed  --  it emerges from the material's own dynamics.

chapters.name: Isosurfaces: Implicit to Explicit
chapters.truth: Define a field, extract a surface. The boundary between inside and outside becomes geometry.

chapters.name: Boolean Surfaces: CSG as Composition
chapters.truth: Composition is not addition. Boolean ops give us a lawful way to compose solids: A∪B, A∩B, A−B. Every architectural cavity is a difference; every joint is an intersection.

chapters.name: Swarm Intelligence: No Leader, Yet Coordinated
chapters.truth: No leader, yet coordinated. Stigmergy: the environment is the message. Local rules produce global intelligence.

chapters.name: Machine Learning: Algorithms That Learn
chapters.truth: Learning is optimization in a landscape you can't fully see.

chapters.name: Graph Theory: Connections Define Structure
chapters.truth: Everything is a graph if you squint hard enough.

chapters.name: Foundations Crisis: The Limits of Formalization
chapters.truth: Every formal system has an outside. Complete order is impossible.

chapters.name: Post-Crisis: Applied Limits
chapters.truth: Knowing the limits of formalization, what do we build?
